name: Air Combat 1v1 Stage 0 Forced Fire Debug
description: Stage 0 air-combat visualization profile for inspecting the weapon-employment chain against the unarmed flying drone surrogate. Uses a fixed full-action vector that keeps radar/master-arm/fire active so the missile-release, flyout, damage, and combat_win sequence can be watched in examples/viz. Use the 0.1x or 0.05x viz speed controls for slow-motion inspection.
